newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic in Virginia pact with MCI.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic in Virginia pact with MCI.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said Monday that Bell Atlantic-Virginia had entered into a pact with the local service affiliate of MCI Communications Corp to connect their networks in the state.

Bell Atlantic said that this marked the first comprehensive interconnection and resale agreement between a Bell Atlantic company and a major long distance company under section 251 of the Telecommunications Act of 1996.
The seven Bell Atlantic operating companies have now reached 58 comprehensive interconnection agreements with 18 competing local exchange companies, Bell Atlantic said.
Under the pact, MCI will be able to connect its facilities with portions of Bell Atlantic's network to provide local exchange telephone services in competition with Bell Atlantic.
The company said the pact also allows MCI to buy local dialtone service from Bell Atlantic at wholesale prices and resell it to customers.
In addition, the pact covers details as to how the companies will physically connect their networks and the price to be paid for completion of calls on the other's network.
The agreement will be effective when approved by Virginia's State Corporation Commission.
Bell Atlantic cannot offer long distance in its service area until it complies with a 14-point checklist prescribed by the Telecommunications Act.
